matchConditions.name: bootstrap-evidence
matchConditions.expression:
request.name.startsWith('cvk-bootstrap-') || (object != null &&
 ((has(object.metadata.name) && object.metadata.name.startsWith('cvk-bootstrap-')) ||
  (has(object.metadata.annotations) && 'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-binding' in object.metadata.annotations) ||
  (has(object.metadata.labels) && 'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence' in object.metadata.labels) ||
  (has(object.metadata.finalizers) && 'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence-evidence' in object.metadata.finalizers))) ||
(oldObject != null &&
 ((has(oldObject.metadata.name) && oldObject.metadata.name.startsWith('cvk-bootstrap-')) ||
  (has(oldObject.metadata.annotations) && 'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-binding' in oldObject.metadata.annotations) ||
  (has(oldObject.metadata.labels) && 'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence' in oldObject.metadata.labels) ||
  (has(oldObject.metadata.finalizers) && 'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence-evidence' in oldObject.metadata.finalizers)))

validations.expression:
variables.manager && request.namespace == variables.sharedNamespace && ((request.operation == 'CREATE' && object != null &&
  object.metadata.name.matches('^cvk-bootstrap-[a-f0-9]{32}$') &&
  (!has(object.metadata.generateName) || object.metadata.generateName == '') &&
  (!has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) || object.metadata.ownerReferences.size() == 0) &&
  has(object.metadata.finalizers) && object.metadata.finalizers == ['ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence-evidence'] &&
  has(object.metadata.labels) && object.metadata.labels['ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence'] == 'true' &&
  (!('ops.cisco.vk/metadata-fence' in object.metadata.labels) || variables.metadata) &&
  has(object.metadata.annotations) &&
  !('ops.cisco.vk/metadata-fence-release' in object.metadata.annotations) &&
  'ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-binding' in object.metadata.annotations &&
  object.metadata.annotations['ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-binding'].size() > 0 &&
  object.metadata.annotations['ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-binding'].size() <= 8192 &&
  'topology.cisco.vk/retain-lease' in object.metadata.annotations &&
  object.metadata.annotations['topology.cisco.vk/retain-lease'] == 'true' &&
  has(object.spec.holderIdentity) && object.spec.holderIdentity.matches('^controller-bootstrap/[a-f0-9]{64}$') &&
  !has(object.spec.leaseDurationSeconds) && !has(object.spec.acquireTime) &&
  !has(object.spec.renewTime) && !has(object.spec.leaseTransitions) &&
  !has(object.spec.strategy) && !has(object.spec.preferredHolder)) ||
 (request.operation == 'UPDATE' && variables.oldMetadata && variables.metadata &&
  object.spec == oldObject.spec && object.metadata.labels == oldObject.metadata.labels &&
  (!has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) || object.metadata.ownerReferences.size() == 0) &&
  has(object.metadata.annotations) && has(oldObject.metadata.annotations) &&
  oldObject.metadata.annotations.all(k,v, k in object.metadata.annotations && object.metadata.annotations[k] == v) &&
  object.metadata.annotations.all(k,v, k == 'ops.cisco.vk/metadata-fence-release' ||
    (k in oldObject.metadata.annotations && oldObject.metadata.annotations[k] == v)) &&
  (variables.oldReleased ?
    (variables.released && object.metadata.annotations == oldObject.metadata.annotations &&
     (!has(object.metadata.finalizers) || object.metadata.finalizers.size() == 0)) :
    (variables.released &&
     has(oldObject.metadata.finalizers) && oldObject.metadata.finalizers == ['ops.cisco.vk/bootstrap-fence-evidence'] &&
     (!has(object.metadata.finalizers) || object.metadata.finalizers.size() == 0)))) ||
 (request.operation == 'DELETE' && variables.oldMetadata && variables.oldReleased &&
  (!has(oldObject.metadata.finalizers) || oldObject.metadata.finalizers.size() == 0)))
validations.message: only the manager may create retained fences or release marked metadata evidence; unmarked v1, identity changes, expiry and unacknowledged deletion remain forbidden
